title: Wallet shadow-trade contracts v0.1
objective: Define offline, chain-neutral shadow-trade contracts and validation rules for normalized signals, order intents, fills, lots, exits, results, metrics, run manifests, and data-quality events. Enforce source_trade_at versus observed_at versus simulated_order_at semantics; do not implement chain parsing or execution. This common contract is chain-neutral and must not be blocked by BSC stage activation.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute real trades, sign transactions, broadcast transactions, or connect a trading wallet.
Do not read seed phrases, private keys, browser cookies, login sessions, DPAPI material, or trading API keys.
Do not automate a logged-in GMGN page; only consume user-provided offline exports from the private root.
Do not commit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, raw GMGN exports, chainfm_out contents, or private manifests containing raw records.
Do not treat null, unknown, or missing values as zero.
Do not create a cross-chain global wallet score or assume SOL and BSC addresses identify the same entity.
Do not squash, rebase, rewrite pushed history, push to main, or merge a PR.
Do not implement a provider, transaction parser, polling loop, real order path, or cross-chain score.
Every simulated price must be constrained to simulated_order_at or later.
acceptance_commands: MUST IMPLEMENT AND EXECUTE before DONE: tsx src/cli/run-wallet-shadow-trade-contracts-v0-1.ts --private-root "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR" --input-manifest "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR/shadow/shadow_event_input_manifest.json" --output-private "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR/shadow/shadow_trade_contracts_v0_1/"; use authorized real private input, run twice with identical input, verify input/output record counts and identical output SHA-256, write replay_manifest.json and source_hashes.json, and verify chainfm_out is not tracked by Git.
